description: High Yield new issue: one row per bond issuer, with the company information shown on a deal's Transaction Details. Synthetic: dummy companies, plus the bank's BB-rated clients linked by clientId.

properties.name: _id
properties.description: Same as issuerId.

properties.name: issuerId
properties.description: Issuer key.

properties.name: name
properties.description: Issuer name.

properties.name: clientId
properties.description: The bank client this issuer is, when it is one. Omitted for non-clients.

properties.name: industry
properties.description: Industry sector, on the same list as clients.industry.

properties.name: sector
properties.description: Sub-industry.

properties.name: description
properties.description: One-line business description.

properties.name: hqCity
properties.description: Headquarters city.

properties.name: hqState
properties.description: Headquarters US state code. Omitted for linked clients.

properties.name: hqCountry
properties.description: Headquarters country.

properties.name: ownership
properties.description: Ownership type.

properties.name: ticker
properties.description: Equity ticker. Public issuers only.

properties.name: sponsor
properties.description: Private equity owner. Sponsor-backed issuers only.

properties.name: foundedYear
properties.description: Year founded.

properties.name: employees
properties.description: Employee count.

properties.name: ltmRevenueUsd
properties.description: Last-twelve-months revenue.

properties.name: ltmEbitdaUsd
properties.description: Last-twelve-months EBITDA; the denominator of every leverage multiple.

properties.name: ebitdaMarginPct
properties.description: ltmEbitdaUsd / ltmRevenueUsd * 100.

properties.name: corporateRatingSp
properties.description: S&P-style corporate family rating.

properties.name: corporateRatingMoodys
properties.description: Moody's-style corporate family rating.

properties.name: ratingOutlook
properties.description: Rating outlook.

properties.name: website
properties.description: Website (example domain).

description: High Yield new issue: one row per bond transaction - the rows of the New Issue calendar. Priced deals carry the lead tranche's coupon and yield; deals still in market carry price talk instead.

properties.name: _id
properties.description: Same as dealId.

properties.name: dealId
properties.description: Deal key.

properties.name: issuerId
properties.description: Issuer.

properties.name: issuerName
properties.description: Copy of hy_issuers.name, for display.

properties.name: clientId
properties.description: Copy of hy_issuers.clientId when the issuer is a bank client.

properties.name: market
properties.description: Product tab on the New Issue page.

properties.name: status
properties.description: In Market = launched, not priced yet (the default calendar view). Priced = terms set.

properties.name: ourRole
properties.description: Citizens' role on the deal; n/a when Citizens is not in the syndicate.

properties.name: dealType
properties.description: Purpose category.

properties.name: useOfProceeds
properties.description: Use of proceeds as described in the offering.

properties.name: launchDate
properties.description: Date the deal was launched to investors.

properties.name: expectedPricingDate
properties.description: Expected pricing date. In Market deals only.

properties.name: pricedDate
properties.description: Pricing date (the calendar's Priced column). Priced deals only.

properties.name: settlementDate
properties.description: Settlement (closing) date, pricing + 7 days. Priced deals only.

properties.name: dealSizeUsd
properties.description: Total size across tranches.

properties.name: trancheCount
properties.description: Number of tranches.

properties.name: leadTrancheId
properties.description: The largest tranche; callProtection, couponPct, yieldPct and price talk are copied from it.

properties.name: callProtection
properties.description: Lead tranche non-call period (NC2 = non-callable for 2 years).

properties.name: couponPct
properties.description: Lead tranche coupon. Priced deals only.

properties.name: yieldPct
properties.description: Lead tranche yield at issue. Priced deals only.

properties.name: priceTalkLowPct
properties.description: Lead tranche price talk, low end. In Market deals only.

properties.name: priceTalkHighPct
properties.description: Lead tranche price talk, high end. In Market deals only.

properties.name: totalLeverageX
properties.description: Pro forma total debt / LTM EBITDA at pricing (the calendar's Leverage column).

properties.name: securedLeverageX
properties.description: Pro forma secured debt / LTM EBITDA.

properties.name: netLeverageX
properties.description: Pro forma (total debt - cash) / LTM EBITDA.

properties.name: orderbookUsd
properties.description: Final order book across tranches. Priced deals only.

properties.name: oversubscriptionX
properties.description: orderbookUsd / dealSizeUsd. Priced deals only.

properties.name: syndicate
properties.description: Banks on the deal: { bank, role } with role Lead left, Joint book or Co-manager. Fee splits are in hy_fee_economics.

properties.name: ratingSp
properties.description: Issuer corporate rating at launch (S&P style).

properties.name: ratingMoodys
properties.description: Issuer corporate rating at launch (Moody's style).

description: High Yield new issue: one row per tranche (bond) of a deal, with its terms at issuance. Coupon, price, yield, spread and order book exist only once the deal has priced; in-market tranches carry price talk.

properties.name: _id
properties.description: Same as trancheId.

properties.name: trancheId
properties.description: Tranche key: dealId plus T1, T2...

properties.name: dealId
properties.description: Deal.

properties.name: issuerId
properties.description: Issuer.

properties.name: trancheName
properties.description: Short name: coupon and maturity year once priced (7.50% due 2030); seniority and maturity year while in market (Secured notes due 2031).

properties.name: securityDescription
properties.description: Full name with seniority.

properties.name: seniority
properties.description: Seniority.

properties.name: ranking
properties.description: Lien ranking.

properties.name: sizeUsd
properties.description: Tranche size.

properties.name: tenorYears
properties.description: Tenor in years.

properties.name: maturityDate
properties.description: Maturity.

properties.name: callProtection
properties.description: Non-call period.

properties.name: firstCallDate
properties.description: First date the issuer may call the notes.

properties.name: callSchedule
properties.description: Call dates and prices: { callDate, callPrice } with callPrice in % of par.

properties.name: equityClawbackPct
properties.description: Share of the notes the issuer may redeem with equity proceeds during the non-call period.

properties.name: equityClawbackPrice
properties.description: Equity clawback redemption price, % of par (par + coupon).

properties.name: changeOfControlPrice
properties.description: Change of control put price, % of par.

properties.name: couponPct
properties.description: Coupon. Priced only.

properties.name: issuePrice
properties.description: Issue price, % of par. Below 100 = original issue discount. Priced only.

properties.name: yieldPct
properties.description: Yield to maturity at issue. Priced only.

properties.name: spreadBps
properties.description: Spread to the benchmark Treasury at issue. Priced only.

properties.name: orderbookUsd
properties.description: Final order book for the tranche. Priced only.

properties.name: priceTalkLowPct
properties.description: Price talk, low end. In Market only.

properties.name: priceTalkHighPct
properties.description: Price talk, high end. In Market only.

properties.name: ratingSp
properties.description: Issue rating (S&P style); secured notes rate a notch above the issuer.

properties.name: ratingMoodys
properties.description: Issue rating (Moody's style).

properties.name: benchmark
properties.description: Benchmark Treasury.

properties.name: format
properties.description: Offering format.

properties.name: minDenominationUsd
properties.description: Minimum denomination.

properties.name: cusip
properties.description: Dummy CUSIP-style identifier.

description: High Yield new issue: the issuer's pro forma capital structure at the deal, one row per debt instrument in order of seniority, the new notes flagged, then a final cash row. Cumulative leverage runs down the stack.
grain: one row per instrument per deal

properties.name: _id
properties.description: dealId plus CS and the rank.

properties.name: dealId
properties.description: Deal.

properties.name: issuerId
properties.description: Issuer.

properties.name: rank
properties.description: Display order, most senior first; cash is last.

properties.name: instrument
properties.description: Instrument name.

properties.name: seniority
properties.description: Seniority.

properties.name: amountUsd
properties.description: Outstanding amount pro forma for the deal; negative on the cash row.

properties.name: committedUsd
properties.description: Commitment. Revolving credit facility only.

properties.name: maturityYear
properties.description: Maturity year. Not on the cash row.

properties.name: pricing
properties.description: Coupon or margin as text (SOFR + 300, 7.125%, or price talk). Not on the cash row.

properties.name: trancheId
properties.description: The tranche, on rows for this deal's new notes.

properties.name: isNewIssue
properties.description: True on this deal's new notes.

properties.name: cumulativeDebtUsd
properties.description: Running total of amountUsd down to this row; on the cash row it is net debt.

properties.name: cumulativeLeverageX
properties.description: cumulativeDebtUsd / issuer LTM EBITDA; on the cash row it is net leverage.

description: High Yield new issue: the incurrence covenant package on a deal's notes, one row per covenant.
grain: one row per covenant per deal

properties.name: _id
properties.description: dealId plus CV and a number.

properties.name: dealId
properties.description: Deal.

properties.name: issuerId
properties.description: Issuer.

properties.name: category
properties.description: Covenant category.

properties.name: name
properties.description: Covenant name as in the indenture.

properties.name: test
properties.description: Plain-English summary of the test and baskets.

properties.name: ratioThresholdX
properties.description: Ratio test level, where the covenant has one.

properties.name: basketUsd
properties.description: Dollar basket or threshold, where the covenant has one.

properties.name: basketPctEbitda
properties.description: Basket as a percent of EBITDA (grower component), where it has one.

properties.name: suspendsOnInvestmentGrade
properties.description: True if the covenant falls away while the notes are rated investment grade.

description: High Yield new issue: final allocations of each priced tranche, by investor type and by investor region. Within a tranche and dimension, allocationPct sums to 100 and allocationUsd to the tranche size.

properties.description: trancheId plus AL, I (investor type) or R (region) and a number.

properties.description: Deal.

properties.name: trancheId
properties.description: Tranche.

properties.name: issuerId
properties.description: Issuer.

properties.name: dimension
properties.description: How the allocation is cut.

properties.name: category
properties.description: Investor type (High yield funds, Asset managers, Insurance companies, Hedge funds, Pension funds, CLOs, Private banks & retail) or region (United States, Europe, Asia & other).

properties.name: allocationPct
properties.description: Share of the tranche.

properties.name: allocationUsd
properties.description: Amount allocated.

description: High Yield new issue: underwriting fee economics of a deal - the gross spread, its components, and each bank's share, with Citizens' share pulled out. Estimated while the deal is in market.

properties.description: Same as dealId.

properties.name: dealId
properties.description: Deal.

properties.name: issuerId
properties.description: Issuer.

properties.name: feeStatus
properties.description: Final once priced; Estimated while in market.

properties.name: grossSpreadPct
properties.description: Gross underwriting spread, % of deal size.

properties.name: grossFeeUsd
properties.description: dealSizeUsd * grossSpreadPct / 100.

properties.name: managementFeePct
properties.description: Management fee share of the gross spread.

properties.name: underwritingFeePct
properties.description: Underwriting fee share of the gross spread.

properties.name: sellingConcessionPct

properties.name: managementFeeUsd
properties.description: Management fee.

properties.name: underwritingFeeUsd
properties.description: Underwriting fee.

properties.name: sellingConcessionUsd
properties.description: Selling concession.

properties.name: syndicate

properties.description: Citizens' fee; 0 when not in the syndicate.
